pulses.name: Copyright Lures Mask a Multi-Stage PureLog Stealer Attack on Key Industries
pulses.description: A sophisticated malware campaign delivering PureLog Stealer has been identified, targeting healthcare, government, hospitality, and education sectors in multiple countries. The attack uses localized copyright violation lures to trick victims into executing a multi-stage infection chain.
